summary: Design artefact extended for PD-05 (Node types). Shared-type definitions updated; PD-05 section appended to src/design/definition.md.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: src/design/definition.md has been extended (not replaced) with a PD-05 section
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: PD-05 section appended after PD-03 traceability table; no existing sections removed or modified beyond the shared-type updates mandated by the task.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: Updated NodeType enum (HUMAN_TASK and TIMER) is documented, replacing USER_TASK and SCRIPT_TASK
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: Shared-types NodeType enum updated in place (USER_TASK→HUMAN_TASK, SCRIPT_TASK→TIMER with explanatory comment). PD-05 section includes before/after enum comparison and documents all downstream rename impacts (graph.zig, definition_test.zig, JSON serialisation, OpenAPI spec, stored JSONB data).

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: Updated GraphNode struct with optional attributes field is documented
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: Shared-types GraphNode struct updated with `attributes: ?[]const u8` field. PD-05 section restates the struct definition and explains the memory ownership contract.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: validateNodeAttributes function signature is documented with full memory contract
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: PD-05 section includes the full function signature, docstring, and explicit memory contract (mirrors the validateGraph contract): allocation, freeing on success, freeing on failure, OutOfMemory guarantee of no allocation.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: Attribute validation rules for all 7 node types are documented
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: Attribute validation rules table covers all 7 NodeType variants: START (none), END (none), HUMAN_TASK (role), SERVICE_TASK (endpoint+timeout_ms), EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY (none), PARALLEL_GATEWAY (none), TIMER (duration_iso8601). Violation codes listed for each.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: ISO 8601 duration validation rules for TIMER are documented
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: ISO 8601 duration validation rules table documents: P prefix required, at least one designator required, P0D permitted, integer-only components, T prefix for time section, TIMER_MISSING_DURATION vs TIMER_INVALID_DURATION distinction.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: All PD-05 acceptance criteria are traceable to design elements
acceptance_criteria_check.evidence: Traceability table maps all 9 PD-05 acceptance criteria (6 main + 3 edge cases: timeout_ms=0 rejected, P0D permitted, extra attributes ignored) to specific design elements.
